newsitem.title: USA: American Bancorp Q3 net rises.
newsitem.headline: American Bancorp Q3 net rises.

text.p: American Bancorp Thursday said it earned $1,253,000, or $0.33 a share in the third quarter ended September 30, compared with $1,128,000, or $0.30 a share for the same period last year.
The company earned $3,495,000, or $0.92 a share, for the nine-month period ended Sept. 30, compared with $3,079,000, or $0.82 a share, for the same period last year.
As of Sept. 30, the company's total assets were $281,767,000 and shareholder equity was $29,719,000, compared with $266,554,000 and $25,367,000, respectively, at the same time last year.
